name: Community — Song + Album Art
author: m-a-p (YuE2) + Black Forest Labs (Flux 2 Klein 4B)
description: Local song generation delivered as an MP4 with album art: your picture, a Character, or art painted by Flux 2 Klein 4B. YuE2 writes full songs with lyrics from a style and a lyric sheet. A Cover Song card sings your lyrics in your style over the melody of a song you upload, and a Swap Album Art card puts new art on a finished song. YuE2 and SheetSage2 are CC-BY-NC-4.0 (non-commercial).

presets.name: YuE2 Song + Album Art
presets.tagline: A full song with lyrics, delivered as an MP4 with its album art
presets.description:
Type a style, add lyrics, get a finished song as an MP4 with its album art - the way a Sora song ships with a thumbnail. SimpliGen has no audio-only output yet, so the song is delivered as a video: your album art (or art painted for you) held on screen for the whole track.

HOW TO USE IT
1. SUBJECT & ACTION = the style as short tags: voice, genre, instruments, mood, tempo. e.g. "female vocal, indie pop, warm acoustic guitar, soft drums, 100 bpm, intimate, bright chorus".
2. CHARACTER DIALOGUE (turn it on) = the lyrics, one line per sung line, with section tags on their own lines: [verse] [chorus] [bridge] [outro]. Separate sections with a blank line.
3. DURATION = the longest the song may run. YuE2 often ends the song earlier on its own; the video always matches the song it actually made.
4. REFERENCE IMAGE (optional) = your album art. A Character works too - your artist on every song. Leave it empty and Flux 2 Klein 4B paints album art from the style (art only, no title lettering). The art is centre-cropped to the aspect ratio you pick; 1:1 is the album shape.

Want a different picture later? The Swap Album Art card puts new art on a finished song without touching the audio. The Delivery dropdown next to Dialogue does nothing here.

LORAS: YuE2 style LoRAs work - for example Atomtan Studio's DreamPop and Old School Hip-Hop (huggingface.co/atomtanstudio/lora-library). Import them with base model YuE2 and put the LoRA's trigger word first in the style, e.g. "sv_dreampop, dream pop, shimmering guitars". LoRAs change the song only, not the painted album art.

YuE2 is licensed CC-BY-NC-4.0: non-commercial use only.

requirements.notes: YuE2 3B int8 convrot (Comfy-Org repack, 4.0 GB, checkpoints\) - LICENSE CC-BY-NC-4.0, non-commercial. Settings from the ComfyUI Text to Music (YuE2) blueprint: ABC score in full mode, KSampler dpm_2/sgm_uniform 32 steps cfg 1. Album art: Flux 2 Klein 4B fp8 (BFL, Apache-2.0, 4.1 GB) + qwen_3_4b_fp4_flux2 (3.85 GB) + Flux 2 VAE, loaded only when no album art is supplied. Output: MP4 at 1 fps, H.264 + AAC. Needs native YuE2 nodes (engine v0.36.0).

presets.name: YuE2 Cover Song + Album Art
presets.tagline: Your lyrics and style over the melody of a song you upload
presets.description:
Make a cover of a song you already have: YuE2 keeps the original's melody and sings YOUR lyrics in YOUR style over it - the same tune as a jazz ballad, a punk track, a lullaby. Delivered as an MP4 with album art, like the other cards in this pack.

HOW TO USE IT
1. SOURCE SONG = REFERENCE AUDIO (mp3, wav, m4a) or REFERENCE VIDEO (an mp4 - its soundtrack is used). Fill one. A clean recording with a clear lead melody works best.
2. SUBJECT & ACTION = the new style as short tags: voice, genre, instruments, mood, tempo. e.g. "soulful jazz-pop, expressive male vocal, Rhodes piano, upright bass, brushed drums, 88 bpm".
3. CHARACTER DIALOGUE (turn it on) = the lyrics to sing, with [verse] / [chorus] tags in the same order as the source song. To keep the ORIGINAL words, paste them here (Suno shows them on the song page). Leave it off and YuE2 writes NEW words to the same tune - only the melody is taken from the source, never its words.
4. DURATION = how much of the source to cover, from the start (SimpliGen trims the source to it). Paste only the lyrics for that part; extra lines get crammed or dropped.
5. REFERENCE IMAGE (optional) = album art, or leave it empty and Flux 2 Klein 4B paints some.

How it works: SheetSage2 transcribes the source's melody into a score, and YuE2 performs it in melody mode, which leaves the arrangement free to change. Transcription mistakes carry into the cover. YuE2 LoRAs work here too. Only cover recordings you have the rights to use.

FIRST USE: after the models download, restart SimpliGen once. SheetSage2 goes into a new audio_encoders model folder, and the engine only picks up new folders when it starts.

YuE2 and SheetSage2 are licensed CC-BY-NC-4.0: non-commercial use only.

video.displayModel: SheetSage2 + YuE2 3B (int8) + Flux 2 Klein 4B album art

requirements.notes: Official ComfyUI Music Cover (YuE2) template: SheetSage2 bf16 (1.4 GB, audio_encoders\) transcribes the source melody to ABC (melody-only), YuE2 3B int8 sings it in melody mode with the user's style + lyrics, KSampler dpm_2/sgm_uniform 32 steps cfg 1. Source = Reference Audio or Reference Video (soundtrack read by LoadAudio). Album art as the song card. First use needs one app restart after the download: the engine maps a new audio_encoders folder only at start (verified 2026-09-18, app 1.63.1). YuE2 + SheetSage2 CC-BY-NC-4.0, non-commercial.

presets.name: Swap Album Art
presets.tagline: New album art on a finished song, audio untouched
presets.description:
Put new album art on a song you already made with a Song + Album Art card. The audio is copied untouched and the new picture is held for the same length - no model loads, it takes seconds.

HOW TO USE IT
1. REFERENCE VIDEO = the song MP4.
2. REFERENCE IMAGE = the new album art (centre-cropped to the aspect ratio you pick).
3. PROMPT = anything, e.g. "new art". SimpliGen requires a prompt on every card; this one ignores it.

requirements.notes: No model. Reads the song MP4's audio, frame count and fps, and writes the same audio under the new picture. Duration is pinned at 360 s because the app trims reference clips to it; the song itself decides the length.
